blocks.body: This page summarizes all Parts and Collections submitted in this project.

blocks.title: Basic Parts
blocks.csv:
Name,Part Number,Type,Description
Gal80 5’ homology region,BBa_26L2KJQX,Homologous Region,This part is designed for the assembly of Gal80 knockout cassette
Gal80 3’ homology region,BBa_26BZN7AE,Homologous Region,This part is designed for the assembly of Gal80 knockout cassette
GPR2 cDNA,BBa_26P7J5V3,CDNA Match,This cDNA encodes GPR2 from the nematode-trapping fungus Orbilia oligospora
STE2 5’ homology region,BBa_260V498D,Homologous Region,This part is designed to replace yeast STE2 with GPR2-sfGFP through homologous recombination (HR)
STE2 3’ homology region,BBa_260VULNA,Homologous Region,This part is designed to replace yeast STE2 with GPR2-sfGFP through homologous recombination (HR)
sfGFP,BBa_26MAY2X6,CDS,Superfolder green fluorescent protein (sfGFP) serves as a fluorescent reporter to assist in determining the subcellular localization of GPR2 in yeast cells
GAL1 and GAL10 bidirectional promoters,BBa_26TDFVI3,Promoter,"The GAL1/GAL10 bidirectional promoters are derived from Saccharomyces cerevisiae, enabling galactose-inducible bidirectional gene expression in yeast"
pRS315 backbone,BBa_26R6CTVF,Plasmid,"This vector for one-step cloning carries the ampicillin resistance gene and restriction sites, allowing autonomous replication in E. coli"
Gal4 3‘ homology region,BBa_26KPW3LZ,Homologous Region,This part is designed to replace yeast Gal4 with DOD-CYP76AD5 through homologous recombination (HR).
Gal4 5‘ homology region,BBa_26T1QDYX,Homologous Region,This part is designed to replace yeast Gal4 with DOD-CYP76AD5 through homologous recombination (HR)
MjDOD,BBa_26ITFFZ0,CDNA Match,"This gene encodes L-DOPA dioxygenase, which oxidizes L-DOPA to betalamic acid"
BvCYP76AD5,BBa_26CD571A,CDNA Match,"This gene encodes tyrosine hydroxylase/cyclase, which converts L-tyrosine into L-DOPA"
p414-TEF1p-Cas9-CYC1t,BBa_26RDB5XU,Circular Plasmid,"This construct contains Cas9 CDS and Trp marker, which drives constitutive Cas9 expression in yeast for CRISPR editing."
STE12 5' homology region,BBa_26CG7I8I,Homologous Region,This part is designed to insert sTF into yeast through homologous recombination (HR)
STE12 3' homology region,BBa_26BLOJK0,Homologous Region,This part is designed to insert sTF into yeast through homologous recombination (HR)
p406TEF1,BBa_26Y1JMT1,Circular Plasmid,"This part contains the TEF1 promoter, CYC1 terminator and URA3 marker gene for amplification of these components."
p426-SNR52p-gRNA.CAN1.Y-SUP4t,BBa_266EBQE1,Circular Plasmid,"This part is a yeast sgRNA expression vector containing the SNR52 promoter and SUP4 terminator, which enables efficient sgRNA transcription and assists CRISPR-Cas9-mediated genome editing in yeast"
p414-Cas9-Leu,BBa_262NU08K,Plasmid,This part is a yeast Cas9 expression vector whose  original nutritional selection marker has been replaced by LEU2
gSTE12,BBa_26VBBFVU,GRNA Gene,This part contains the DNA template for gSTE12 gRNA
gGal4,BBa_26AIA84W,GRNA Gene,This part contains the DNA template for gGal4 gRNA
gSTE2,BBa_26U6Z74A,GRNA Gene,This part contains the DNA template for gSTE2 gRNA
GPR2（N84V） cDNA,BBa_26YCPMQN,CDNA Match,This part contains the mutant cDNA sequence of GPR2
GPR2（V368R） cDNA,BBa_2683TK6Y,CDNA Match,This part contains the mutant cDNA sequence of GPR2
p426-SNR52p-gSTE2-SUP4t,BBa_26TQ18PN,Plasmid,This part contains the DNA sequence encoding gRNA that targets the STE2 gene
p426-SNR52p-gSTE12-SUP4t,BBa_2612RHXO,Plasmid,This part contains the DNA sequence encoding gRNA that targets the STE12 gene
p426-SNR52p-gGal4-SUP4t,BBa_269ZKY8C,Plasmid,This part contains the DNA sequence encoding gRNA that targets the Gal4 gene
pScCEN-ADH1-FMN(yeast)-Myc-6×His,BBa_26RANQPA,Plasmid,"This part is the pScCEN plasmid backbone carrying the ADH1 promoter, yeast-derived FMN gene, Myc tag and 6×His tag"

blocks.title: Composite Parts
blocks.csv:
Name,Part Number,Type,Description
KOGAL80,BBa_26OPIZCX,Assembly Component,This cassette is used for knocking out the Gal80 gene in the yeast genome via homologous recombination (HR)
TRP1 marker gene,BBa_26WLH0UL,CDS,"The Trp1 gene encodes an enzyme involved in Trp biosynthesis, serving as a nutritional selection marker for yeast."
LEU2 marker gene,BBa_26DW2ZT7,CDS,"The LEU2 gene encodes an enzyme involved in Leu biosynthesis, serving as a nutritional selection marker for yeast."
pRS315-TEF1p-GPR2-sfGFP,BBa_260J9X0X,Plasmid,
Ura3 marker gene,BBa_26OPQ6RW,CDS,"The Ura3 gene encodes an enzyme involved in uracil biosynthesis, serving as a nutritional selection marker for yeast."
pRS315-MjDOD-BvCYP76AD5,BBa_26PGUFWX,Plasmid,"This part contains betaxanthin-related genes, with homology arms for the knock-in of constitutively expressed betaxanthin biosynthetic genes"
Gal1/10bp-Betaxanthin Expression Cassette,BBa_2697LAQW,Assembly Component,This part contains the betaxanthin biosynthetic genes (MjDOD and BvCYP76AD5) under the control of the Gal1/10 bidirectional promoter
pRS315-sTF,BBa_2687EQID,Plasmid,This part is used for amplifying the homologous recombination fragment for sTF assembly
sTF Expression Cassette,BBa_26IOTMOF,Assembly Component,This part is designed for CRISPR-Cas9-mediated knock-in to express sTF in yeast
pRS315-TEF1p-GPR2,BBa_26ZT9H48,Plasmid,This part is designed for CRISPR-Cas9-mediated knock-in of the constitutively expressed GPR2 gene
pRS315-TEF1p-GPR2-N84V,BBa_2628FZFH,Plasmid,This part is designed for CRISPR-Cas9-mediated knock-in of the constitutively expressed GPR2 gene with N84V mutation
pRS315-TEF1p-GPR2-V368R,BBa_26XA2JFQ,Plasmid,This part is designed for CRISPR-Cas9-mediated knock-in of the constitutively expressed GPR2 gene with V368R mutation
